_note: A constraint shifts the shape of the solution; none bans a topic. roll.mjs applies one to about half the cells. 'not_with' lists lens ids it contradicts or repeats.

constraints.text: it must be shippable in one day
it is worth a whole month, so think bigger than a patch
it may not add a dependency or a new config file
it must delete at least as much code as it adds
it must be invisible until something goes wrong
it must work with zero configuration and undo with one command
it must help someone who will never read the docs
it must be demonstrable in a thirty-second screen recording
it may not touch the most-changed file named in the evidence
it may change exactly one default and nothing else
